title: Meet My Younger Self — School

inputs.label: Child identity reference
inputs.role: strict identity, age, face, hairstyle, child wardrobe reference

inputs.label: Adult identity reference
inputs.role: strict identity, age, face, hairstyle, adult wardrobe reference

inputs.label: 3x2 storyboard
inputs.role: action, blocking, adult entrance from screen-right, interaction sequence only

reference_hierarchy: character sheets define wardrobe and accessories
storyboard defines action and composition only

child.wardrobe: mustard/ochre knitted sweater with dark Nordic deer/tree pattern, blue collared shirt, dark trousers, black school shoes
child.accessory: vintage brown leather rectangular school briefcase with short top handle and metal clasp

adult.wardrobe: dark charcoal or graphite tailored blazer, dark shirt or polo, dark trousers, restrained contemporary footwear
adult.accessory: the same type of vintage brown leather rectangular school briefcase as the child, matching proportions, handle and clasp

story_beats.action: Child stands alone in classroom, facing camera, holding briefcase; calm, slightly serious expression.
Child senses someone on screen-right; eyes react first, then head and shoulders turn right; curiosity and mild surprise.
Adult physically enters from OFF-SCREEN RIGHT through the classroom doorway, walking toward the child, carrying the matching briefcase; warm recognition begins.
Adult reaches child, places one arm around shoulders and affectionately ruffles the child’s hair with the free hand; child relaxes and smiles.
They turn together toward camera; adult keeps arm around child; both smile naturally; both briefcases remain visible.
Both slightly raise matching briefcases, exchange amused glance, gently tap the briefcases together, then look back to camera for final hold.

camera.movement: almost static; optional very subtle push-in
camera.blocking: child center-left; reserve negative space on screen-right for adult entrance

visual_style.color: natural restrained warmth, no orange cast
visual_style.environment: authentic lived-in school classroom matching the era, not a museum set
visual_style.texture: subtle photographic texture, no glossy AI aesthetic

negative_constraints: no body fusion or body intersection
no extra limbs, hands or fingers
no backpack, crossbody bag, laptop bag or modern business briefcase
no text, subtitles, logos or watermark
